purpose: Teach: 白色/股/壺/杭/便器/ふじ/カンガルー/凡人

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、白色のスニーカー履いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you wore white sneakers that day.
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Quick and pointed. Slight lift at the end like she's caught him at something small.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、体育で股関節伸ばすの苦手だったろ、桜
lines.en: You were terrible at hip stretches in PE, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, half-smile tone. Turn it back on her without heat. Quick beat before her name—mild payback for the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行で壺、つまり信楽焼の見学したろ
lines.en: Riku, on the school trip you went to see Shigaraki pottery, didn't you?
lines.style: Same teasing tempo as line 1. Light curiosity mixed with 'I know something about you' energy. Natural, conversational.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、林間学校でテントの杭打ち手伝ってたな、桜
lines.en: You helped drive tent stakes at summer camp, remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm observation. Not challenging—just noting what he saw. Slight warmth underneath the matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家の便器掃除自分でやってるって偉いな
lines.en: Riku, you clean your own toilet at home—that's impressive.
lines.style: Genuine admiration underneath teasing surface. No sarcasm here. Light, warm beat before his name. Respect slipping through.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で富士、つまりふじ山の標高覚えたろ、桜
lines.en: You memorized Mount Fuji's elevation for social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Same calm rhythm as line 4. Collecting small facts about her. Patient, like he's been paying attention longer than she thinks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、修学旅行先でカンガルー観たろ
lines.en: Riku, you saw kangaroos on the school trip.
lines.style: Statement of fact, lighter this time. Shorter. A small smile in the voice—she likes catching him with these details.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「自分は凡人」って自虐してたな、桜
lines.en: You put yourself down as ordinary, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Wry, quiet. No judgment. Close to her, like they're in on this together. Slight trailing-off—he's not asking for an answer.
